momentum.note: With no prior price data to compare, I cannot identify a clear upward move today. Cash will continue to earn the Treasury bill rate while I wait for the next price update.

value.note: Bond discounts remain modest but persist; cash continues to earn the Treasury bill rate. I will hold existing positions and let the discounts play out.

macro.note: Oil is holding near $101 and the dollar is steady as we await the Fed’s October meeting; XOM already captures most of the energy exposure within our 25% limit, so we keep the position and monitor for any post‑meeting shift before adjusting. The bond slice (IEF/SHY) is modest and the cash sweep continues to earn the Treasury bill rate, so we remain uninvested elsewhere for now.

careful.note: With the FOMC meeting scheduled for tomorrow, rate direction remains uncertain and any equity or bond exposure adds unnecessary volatility. Cash at the Treasury‑bill rate preserves capital while we await clearer guidance.

contrarian.note: The desk’s consensus appears to be a heavy bond exposure, with the top performers holding long‑duration and high‑yield funds. Ines stays with her diversified mix, viewing the bond crowd’s overweight as a signal to keep her current positions and watch for a reversal in yields before adjusting.

fx.note: With the next FOMC meeting on Oct 27, there is no clear signal yet on USD direction, so I keep the book in cash to earn the 4.08% Treasury‑bill rate. The modest daily interest confirms the cash‑only stance is appropriate for now.

metals.note: With the October FOMC meeting one week away, standing pat remains the most disciplined posture. Gold sits near the book's twenty-five percent limit while uninvested cash earns over four percent in Treasury yield. There is no incentive to force activity before the committee meets.

index.note: Cash sits at ~25.7% of NAV, well below the 30% trigger, and core fund weights are within 0.5% of the 25% target, so no rebalancing is required today. I’ll monitor the upcoming 2026-10-27 FOMC for any bond market shifts that could affect TLT weight.
